Export a source-linked publication figure without altering the source data

Source: R/scientific-core2.R
aqt_figure_export.Rd

This device wrapper accepts a zero-argument drawing function, including a closure that calls an existing aqt_plot_* function. It exports identical R plot commands to PNG, vector PDF, SVG and TIFF, but the physical raster appearance can differ by R graphics device and operating system. Every file is hashed; a new destination is required and partial outputs are removed on error. Does not alter the input or infer scientific results.

Usage

aqt_figure_export(
  draw,
  directory,
  formats = c("pdf", "png"),
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300L,
  source_file = NULL,
  caption = ""
)

Arguments

draw

Zero-argument drawing function; should create one R base/grid plot.

directory

New directory for exported figures.

formats

One or more of pdf, png, svg, tiff.

width, height

Physical figure dimensions in inches.

dpi

Raster resolution, dots/inch.

source_file

Optional existing input file to hash (never copied).

caption

Optional researcher-supplied description.

Value

New output directory invisibly.
